sections.Profile:
Sing Along and Melody , both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1967, are nearly identical electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm. Sing Along is the replay version, while Melody is the add-a-ball variant. Both games feature a lively music theme, with Melody incorporating caroling motifs.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1967
